# Dress Doctor

> Dress Doctor is a professional laundry service in Douala, Cameroon. We collect customers' laundry for free, clean it with care, and deliver it back to their door. Our standard turnaround is 24–72 hours, with a 24-hour express service.

Dress Doctor offers laundry, wash-and-fold, washing and ironing, dry cleaning, shoe cleaning, and care for selected household fabrics. The website is available in English and French. Prices are in Central African CFA francs (XAF).

## What We Offer

- **Wash & fold:** 700 XAF per kg, with a 5 kg minimum.
- **Wash, dry & iron:** 1,000 XAF per kg, with a 3 kg minimum.
- **Wash per piece:** From 700 XAF per piece for adults and 200 XAF for children.
- **Ironing & pressing:** From 500 XAF per piece.
- **Dry cleaning:** From 2,500 XAF.
- **Bedding & home care:** From 1,500 XAF, for items such as bedsheets, duvets, curtains and pillowcases.
- **Shoes and sneakers:** From 2,000 XAF per pair.
- **Pickup and delivery:** Free anywhere in Douala.
- **Express service:** 24-hour turnaround.

Customers can book laundry pickups online and use the website to view order details, track orders and receive updates.

## Monthly Laundry Plans

All plans include free pickup and delivery anywhere in Douala, and customers can stop at any time. Paying every 3 months saves 10%.

- **Basic:** 20,000 XAF per month. 40 pieces or 23 kg per month. Good for students and people living alone.
- **Standard:** 40,000 XAF per month. 100 pieces or 50 kg per month. Good for workers and couples.
- **Premium:** 65,000 XAF per month. 200 pieces or 85 kg per month. For big families, with orders handled first.

Extra clothes beyond a plan are charged at the normal price, per piece or per kg, whichever is cheaper for the customer.

## Contact

- **Phone and WhatsApp:** +237 689 688 248 and +237 654 030 978
- **Email:** info@dressdoctor.io
- **Location:** Douala, Cameroon. The factory is at 105, behind Château Bonaberi. The office is at Bépanda Bonabo, directly opposite Génie Militaire. Dress Doctor is a pickup-and-delivery service, so customers should book online or contact us before visiting either location.
- **Opening hours:** Monday to Saturday, 8:00 am–7:00 pm; closed Sunday.

## Payments

Customers pay when their laundry is delivered, using cash, MTN Mobile Money or Orange Money.

## If Something Goes Wrong

If we damage something, we repair or replace it. If a customer is not happy with the cleaning, we clean it again for free.

## Additional Information

For current prices, available services, booking conditions and other policies, consult the relevant pages on the official website. Where information differs, the current official website and applicable service terms should take precedence.
